services.name: Night Skyline Cruise with Open Bar
2 Hours Miami Private Boat Rental
services.desc: Unlike shared tours, this private yacht sails with a minimum of 25 guests, giving your group exclusive use of the vessel. Cruise Biscayne Bay and enjoy Miami’s stunning skyline with a licensed captain, fuel included, and spacious open decks perfect for dancing, relaxing, or celebrating special occasions. A Bluetooth stereo lets you play your own music, and a cooler with ice is provided so you can bring your own food at no extra cost, or choose from additional beverage options. With panoramic views of Star Island mansions and no crowds to share the space, this yacht rental is ideal for birthdays, bar/bat mitzvahs, bachelor/ette parties, and family gatherings. Beverages and drinks available

blurb: Guests can enjoy various boat cruises on Biscayne Bay including sightseeing, party cruises with DJs, and private yacht rentals. Cruises feature views of the Miami skyline, Star Island celebrity homes, and include options like open bars and snacks. Private yacht rentals require a minimum of 25 guests and include a licensed captain and fuel.
